# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pārājika 7 (Bi-Vb Pj7)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Pj7
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pārājika 7
**Title (English, from literature):** The training rule on siding with an ejected monk

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Ukkhittānuvattikā-sikkhāpada* constitutes the seventh *pārājika* offense in the Pali *Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga* of the Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule establishes that a nun who persistently associates with or sides with a monk who has been legitimately suspended or ejected (*ukkhitta*) by the monastic community incurs expulsion (*pārājika*) from the order. In modern scholarship, an English translation has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

 In other lineages, the counterpart frequently appears as the eighth *pārājika* (or the seventh in the Mahīśāsaka tradition), with extant parallels preserved in Chinese (Dharmaguptaka, Sarvāstivāda, Mahīśāsaka, Mūlasarvāstivāda, and Mahāsāṃghika recensions), Tibetan (*Bhikṣuṇīvinayavibhaṅga*), and Sanskrit manuscripts (including Sarvāstivāda and Mahāsāṃghika-Lokottaravāda versions).

Text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus indicates extensive internal Pali alignment with the *Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha* (specifically §1.11.1_0–1.15) and disciplinary formulae shared with *Saṅghādisesa* procedures across both the *Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga* (Ss 4, 10, 11, 12, 13) and the *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* (Ss 10, 12, 13, and Pc 68), as well as the *Bhikkhunikkhandhaka* (Kd 20) and later commentary literature [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns segments of this text with Sanskrit Vinaya materials (such as the *Saṅghabhedavastu* and *Kośāmbakavastu*) and Tibetan Vinaya collections (including the *Bhikṣuṇīvinayavibhaṅga*, *Vinayavastu*, and *Vinayasūtraṭīkā*) [DharmaNexus].
